### Booking Holdings to Webcast Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 3


October 6, 2026


NORWALK, Conn.


, Oct. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) announced today that it intends to hold a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, November 3 at 4:30 p.m. ET. The event will be webcasted at[ir.bookingholdings.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=1618648293&u=http%3A%2F%2Fir.bookingholdings.com%2F&a=ir.bookingholdings.com) and the audio will be available for replay on the website for seven days thereafter.


Booking Holdings will post a release containing its third quarter 2026 financial results on the company's Investor Relations website,[ir.bookingholdings.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=1618648293&u=http%3A%2F%2Fir.bookingholdings.com%2F&a=ir.bookingholdings.com) , at approximately 4:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, November 3.


Source: Booking Holdings
#BKNG_Earnings


**About Booking Holdings** Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and services that support the entire travel journey. Our platforms - including[Booking.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=2819166982&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.booking.com%2F&a=Booking.com) ,[Priceline](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=2220932894&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.priceline.com%2F&a=Priceline) ,[Agoda](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=3228875346&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.agoda.com%2F&a=Agoda) ,[KAYAK](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=1054290115&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kayak.com%2F&a=KAYAK) and[OpenTable](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=1292816092&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opentable.com%2F&a=OpenTable) - utilize advanced AI, machine learning and other innovative technologies to simplify and personalize the travel experience for consumers and partners in over 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit[BookingHoldings.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786948-1&h=532234760&u=http%3A%2F%2Fbookingholdings.com%2F&a=BookingHoldings.com) and follow us on X @BookingHoldings.
